description: This file defines a controller class named SponsorsSubController within the Goteo project, specifically managing administrative actions related to sponsors, such as listing, editing, adding, reordering, and deleting sponsor entries.

classes.name: SponsorsSubController
classes.description: Controller class responsible for managing sponsor entities within the admin section, including permissions, CRUD operations, and ordering.

methods.name: isAllowed
methods.description: Checks if a user has permission to access sponsor management for a specific node.

methods.name: checkItemPermission
methods.description: Verifies if the current user can manage a specific sponsor item.

methods.name: editAction
methods.description: Handles editing an existing sponsor or processing the submitted form data for updates.

methods.name: getFormFields
methods.description: Generates form fields configuration for sponsor creation or editing.

methods.name: addAction
methods.description: Handles the process of adding a new sponsor.

methods.name: listAction
methods.description: Displays a list of sponsors associated with the current node.

methods.name: upAction
methods.description: Moves a sponsor up in the display order.

methods.name: downAction
methods.description: Moves a sponsor down in the display order.
